name: Kin Khao
address: Parc 55 San Francisco - a Hilton Hotel, 55 Cyril Magnin St., San Francisco, CA 94102
dinnerNote: À la carte, to share; curries about $47–$57
dinnerNoteZh: 單點，供分享；咖哩約47至57美元
hotel: the Parc 55 San Francisco, a Hilton hotel
bookingOpens: Online on Resy for up to seven at dinner and up to ten at lunch; larger parties book by email (info@kinkhao.com).
cancellation: Cancelling within 24 hours or not showing up costs $20 a person for parties of up to five, $50 a person for six or more. Only complete parties are seated, and tables are held for 15 minutes.
walkIns: A few bar and dining-room seats are kept for walk-ins.
groups: Dinner parties of eight or more and lunch parties of 11 or more book by email and all take the prix fixe menu ($105 a person at dinner, $55 at lunch); groups of 19 or more need a half or full buyout. A 20% gratuity is added for six or more.
children: Children are welcome, but the food is spicy and there are no children's dishes; say in advance if children or a pram are coming.
duration: Tables are booked for about 1¾ hours for two and 2 hours for three to six.
byob: Up to two 750ml bottles at $50 corkage each ($100 a magnum), not for wines on the list; one corkage fee is waived for each bottle bought from the list.
